message.content: {"key_mechanism_gt": "Palladium/norbornene cooperative catalysis enables sequential functionalization of nonaromatic substrates via a mechanism involving norbornene as a transient mediator to form polysubstituted alkenes.", "key_mechanism_gen": "Norbornene acts as a transient alkenyl ligand that traps allyl-Pd intermediates, preventing over-addition and enforcing regioselective insertion to form trisubstituted alkenes.", "recovery": "PARTIAL", "rationale": "Both hypotheses involve norbornene-mediated palladium catalysis, but the ground truth focuses on sequential functionalization of nonaromatic substrates, while the generated hypothesis emphasizes allylic electrophile coupling and steric control, diverging in the specific mechanistic pathway."}
